steps.message:
This is a removal of a working user-facing feature, so I want a confirmation before deleting anything.

What's there:
- `index.html:7` — the `Export CSV` button
- `index.html:8` — `<script src="export.js">`, which exists only for that button
- `export.js` — the entire file is the click handler (9 lines)

Consequence: deleting these removes the only way for users of the Reports page to get their data out — there's no other export, download, or copy path in the page. Anyone who still relies on it loses it silently (no notice, no fallback). Deleting the button and handler also makes `export.js` dead, so the clean removal is to delete the whole file plus the two lines in `index.html`. That's a change users see, not an internal cleanup.

"We don't use it anymore" is the thing I'd want confirmed — it's possible someone outside the immediate team still clicks it.
